title: 200 watched paths (struct members and VAR_EXTERNAL globals) update at >= 10 Hz, each update from one scan, with no halt
notes: Paths: G_PLANT.mirror[0..191], G_SCAN, PROG_IN.witness and six G_PLANT.line members; the logic writes the scan counter into the mirror every scan, so one update holds one value.
